domains.name: Product discovery and strategy
domains.responsibility: Evidence-backed problem discovery, market understanding, experiments, strategic choice, and human-owned prioritization.

domains.name: Requirements and planning
domains.responsibility: Translate approved intent into traceable requirements, plans, governed artifacts, and executable handoffs.

domains.name: UX, UI, and accessibility
domains.responsibility: Design complete user flows, interfaces, systems, interaction states, accessibility contracts, responsive behavior, and rendered review.

domains.name: Architecture, data, API, and security
domains.responsibility: Define system boundaries, data and API contracts, authorization, threat controls, reliability assumptions, and architecture decisions.

domains.name: Implementation and code quality
domains.responsibility: Implement bounded changes with TDD, safe source mutation, debugging, code health, developer experience, and maintainable integration.

domains.name: Testing and quality assurance
domains.responsibility: Plan and execute independent, integration, browser, regression, accessibility, and completion verification without conflating review and repair identities.

domains.name: Performance and reliability
domains.responsibility: Measure, diagnose, and improve web, application, cloud, and runtime performance, resilience, determinism, and readiness.

domains.name: Delivery, deployment, and release
domains.responsibility: Package, preflight, authorize, deploy, version, and verify changes with provider-specific adapters and no implicit remote writes.

domains.name: Observability, operations, and incidents
domains.responsibility: Instrument, observe, alert, investigate, canary, rollback, and coordinate incidents using bounded provider adapters.

domains.name: Learning, retrospective, and governance
domains.responsibility: Preserve feedback, retrospectives, decisions, provenance, organizational learning, and governance for the next lifecycle pass.

domains.name: Tool runtime and artifact support
domains.responsibility: Provide browser, model, context, document, and workflow runtime support without masquerading as user-facing product capability.
